Lemma
[Nonnegative Hessian in the support sense] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0462 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h37-directional-gradient-inequality 1. apph:H.39\group Generalized gradients

At every interior point of a connected locally convex set, a convex function has $\operatorname {Hess}_{\mathrm{sup}}f\ge 0$ and is twice differentiable in the sense of Stolz almost everywhere.
